classification: derived product adapter for already-proven native consumers; no new wire grammar
observed_product_gap: web/legacy-game-client.mjs configures no battle ports and creates only an ordinary canvas host
web/game-app.mjs hides the stage during battle-pending and provides no battle input
shared client already owns source battle render/cancel/return jobs, catalog identity and actual HP/MP values

source_contracts.contract: Entry/input/loop/exit/return are actual owned core consumers; battle mode stops old ordinary runtime and only actual final ordinary frame success reestablishes a new runtime

Source input uses menu/state/gate/eligible masks and accepts one pending intent per callback. Attack then target sendsH|A; guardG, escapeE, positionP. UI must wait for actual intent consumption; unavailable submenus remain explicit
C data owns names, slots and four values; live body vitals reflect actual animation results and next actual C replaces them. UI must not mutate the world or decide damage/progress

A browser adapter may bind existing actual library ports, await each real battle job, present its actual RGBA and provide semantic buttons/eligible target list. This is an independent accessible product control surface, not a claim of native menu/art/hit/audio equivalence

intended_implementation: Bind actual battle catalogs/entry/input/loop/exit/return once to each real browser client, and hand off ordinary/battle asynchronous canvas ownership with bounded timer and render cancellation
Add responsive accessible battle controls backed by actual source readiness, C names/current vitals/eligible targets/countdown; pause/disconnect and page visibility retain ownership
Keep unsupported source dependencies visible and non-progressing without repeated callback spam or fabricated completion; reentry/return/close discard stale presentation work
Verify real product file/transport/canvas interactions and ordinary regression on desktop/touch mobile, plus targeted/full source/generated checks and exact source byte requests
validation_flow: game.html -> user selects actual original startup/resource files -> normal source character entry -> real battle packets -> actual canvas/input/result -> real exit/return -> ordinary movement
Browser_plugin: absent; Browser plugin not available; use existing regular Playwright1.64.1/installed Chrome, no new dependency installation
required_remaining: Full other battle skills/handlers, source-native menu/hit/render/audio/alternate renderer and all character branches
Other main9/native pool scheduling and historical unconfigured49 unification
Full nonbattle gameplay and complete product platform behaviors
Native WeChat gamePage/Canvas/files/network/fonts/audio/scheduler, DevTools and device acceptance
Current-version/official login/gameplay/recovery acceptance; no test account
presentation_contract: Browser requests actual native640x480 battle presentation through a validated configureBattleViewport port; existing component defaults still crop to their ordinary context. Ordinary scene dimensions/context remain unchanged on return. copyBattleState exposes the already-owned small battle snapshot instead of copying full world/map per frame. Visual CRT RNG is initialized from this client clock; full native global RNG/cadence equivalence is not claimed.
accessibility: Stable live status and unchanged name/vital text update only when values change; desktop/mobile real MutationObservers verify no repeated live-region mutations while actual battle callbacks continue.
